title: Filming: Arrow Through Me by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings filmed a promotional clip for the Back To The Egg song ‘Arrow Through Me’ on 20 June 1979.

It directed by Keith ‘Keef’ McMillan, who had shot promos for several other songs from the Back To The Egg album the previous week.

The ‘Arrow Through Me’ video featured four of Wings playing keyboards or synthesizers, plus Steve Holley playing the drums. The footage was processed during post-production to give various visual effects including saturation and multiple overlaid sequences.

McMillan’s promos were part of a planned Back To The Egg TV special, which was planned for broadcast in November 1979 in America. Wings had few plans to promote the album, although they undertook a UK tour later in the year and had planned a Japanese tour in early 1980 which was cancelled following Paul McCartney’s arrest in Tokyo on 16 January.
